name: argus
description: An AI agent with advanced tool-calling capabilities, featuring a flexible toolsets system for organizing and managing tools.
comment:install: This is an npm workspaces monorepo: every workspace's dependencies hoist into
the SINGLE root node_modules (the lockfile expects ~1178 top-level packages,
while root package.json declares only 3 of them — the rest belong to web /
Therefore: ALWAYS install from the repo root, and NEVER pass --workspace.
A per-workspace install recomputes the whole tree from that one workspace's
point of view and DELETES the packages it considers extraneous — so running a
'web only' install silently removes apps/desktop's vitest/typescript/jsdom
from the shared root node_modules. That is what the removed install:web /
install:tui / install:desktop / install:root scripts did, and it presented as
'I never touched node_modules but packages keep disappearing'.
Prefer `npm ci` over `npm install`: it installs strictly from the lockfile and
wipes node_modules first, so you cannot end up in a half-installed state.
If tarballs report 'seems to be corrupted', that is the registry (or a stale
~/.npm/_cacache copy), not the tree: `npm cache clean --force`, then reinstall.
audit:* below are read-only and safe. `npm audit fix --workspace <name>` is NOT
(same tree-rewrite hazard as install), which is why no audit:fix:* script exists.

scripts.postinstall: echo '✅ Browser tools ready. Run: python run_agent.py --help'
